text: Harness: record actual tokens, money and time per idea as its realized cost
description: Every stage reports provider usage (tokens in/out, $ from a per-model price table, wall time). Sum per idea and per cycle; store on the idea as actual cost next to the estimate. Enforce a per-cycle and per-day budget in the harness. This is exactly the data the priority-model calibration (b2a7c3cf) is waiting for: estimated vs actual cost on 30+ ideas.
